title: TerraGroup Labs arsenal storage room key

infobox.usage: Unlocks the storage room door inside the laboratory security arsenal (R23) in The Lab.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: TerraGroup Labs arsenal storage room key (TGL ASR) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Key to the TerraGroup Labs Security arsenal storage room.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text:
- Sitting on a chair within a shack on top of the hill with the transmission tower

Map with location marked

Key on the chair

- Room 215 of the three-story dorms: Inside a night stand

Key in the night stand

- On the counter behind the cash registers in the new gas station

Key on the counter

- In the guard building of the crane yard next to the new gas station, in the right side shelf of the desk (Requires a Factory emergency exit key to access).

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the storage room inside the laboratory security arsenal (R23) on the second level in The Lab. A TerraGroup Labs keycard (Red) is required to access it.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Valuables
- Weapon mods
- Meds and Medical supplies
- One Drawer
